fullTextEN: Hello, everyone!
I am Teacher Bella.
I am from Taiwan.

fullTextZH: 你知道世界上最冷的地方在哪里吗？
fullTextEN: Do you know where the coldest place in the world is?
Yes, it's in Antarctica.
But that place,
no one lives there.
Then do you know
there is a place that is very cold,

fullTextZH: 听说是世界上最冷的国家，
fullTextEN: it's said to be the coldest country in the world,

fullTextZH: 而且呐，这个地方有人住。
fullTextEN: and, this place has people living there.
Do you know where it is?
That's right, it's in Russia.
Not long ago,
I watched a video,

fullTextZH: 这个影片介绍世界上最冷的国家。
fullTextEN: This video introduces the coldest country in the world.
This place,
is in the northeast of Russia.
It's said that,

fullTextZH: 这个地方是世界上最冷的城市。
fullTextEN: this place is the coldest city in the world.

fullTextZH: 冬天最冷的时候可以到零下70度！
fullTextEN: In the coldest part of winter, it can reach minus 70 degrees!
Colder than your refrigerator.
Over there,
Winter lasts a long time,
It's about 6 months, 7 months.
So the people who live there,

fullTextZH: 每次出门都要穿很厚、很厚的外套，
fullTextEN: Every time they go out, they have to wear very thick coats,

fullTextZH: 然后还需要戴手套和帽子。
fullTextEN: and they also need to wear gloves and hats.

fullTextZH: 如果没有戴帽子和手套，
fullTextEN: If they don't wear hats and gloves,

fullTextZH: 他们的手很快就会冻伤。
fullTextEN: their hands will quickly get frostbite.
So,

fullTextZH: 在这么冷的地方要怎么生活呢？
fullTextEN: How do you live in such a cold place?
Because winter is too cold,
so this place,
has no water pipes.
Because water pipes,

fullTextZH: 在这么冷的天气里会结冰。
fullTextEN: will freeze in such cold weather.
So for them,

fullTextZH: 喝水是一件很麻烦的工作。
fullTextEN: drinking water is a very troublesome task.

fullTextZH: 他们需要到结冰的河旁边，
fullTextEN: They need to go to the frozen riverbank,
Use an axe to cut down the ice blocks,

fullTextZH: 然后呢，再把冰块带回家，
fullTextEN: Then, take the ice blocks back home,

fullTextZH: 放在家里，慢慢的等冰块融化，
fullTextEN: Put them at home and slowly wait for the ice blocks to melt,
only then can you have water to drink.
Unlike us,

fullTextZH: 在家里打开水龙头，就有水可以喝。
fullTextEN: at home, just turn on the tap and there's water to drink.
Because it's really too cold here,

fullTextZH: 所以要种水果、蔬菜非常的难。
fullTextEN: it's very difficult to grow fruits and vegetables.
During the hotter times in summer,

fullTextZH: 他们会把一些食物放盐、
fullTextEN: they will salt some food,

fullTextZH: 和糖，所以可以放得比较久。
fullTextEN: and add sugar, so it can be stored longer.
Then during winter,
they eat this food.
Also, in this place,
when driving,
you must not turn off the engine.
Why?

fullTextZH: 因为啊，如果你熄火，车里面的水就会结冰。
fullTextEN: Because if you turn off the engine, the water inside the car will freeze.
After it freezes,
you can't continue driving.
So because of this,
You might often see
Cars running on the road,
but no one inside.
So here,

fullTextZH: 人们都会用一种特别的停车库。
fullTextEN: People use a special parking garage.
What is this?
That's right, just like the photo,
They put a coat on the car.

fullTextZH: 这样呢，车子就不会太冷。
fullTextEN: This way, the car won't be too cold.
Besides the car,

fullTextZH: 如果你想在外面用你的手机，
fullTextEN: If you want to use your phone outside,

fullTextZH: 那么你可能需要在30秒以内用完，
fullTextEN: then you might need to finish in 30 seconds,
because iPhones will shut down due to the cold,
after 30 seconds they will turn off.
So in such a cold place,
Do children need to go to school?
Of course,
There,

fullTextZH: 如果天气是零下54度以上，
fullTextEN: if the temperature is below minus 54 degrees,

fullTextZH: 那么啊，孩子们就需要去学校；
fullTextEN: So, the children need to go to school;

fullTextZH: 可是啊，如果比零下55度冷，
fullTextEN: But, if it's colder than minus 55 degrees,

fullTextZH: 那么孩子们就不需要去学校，
fullTextEN: Then the children don't need to go to school,
because it's too dangerous.
The children here,

fullTextZH: 他们都知道，出门的时候
fullTextEN: They all know, when going out
what kind of clothes they should wear,
because the weather is really too cold,
so when they go out
they all wear many layers of clothes,

fullTextZH: 然后戴手套、帽子和围巾。
fullTextEN: and then wear gloves, hats, and scarves.

fullTextZH: 因为如果你不穿这么多衣服，
fullTextEN: Because if you don't wear so many clothes,
maybe after 10 minutes outside,

fullTextZH: 很快你的手和脸就会变成红色，
fullTextEN: very quickly your hands and face will turn red,
then turn black,
and then slowly lose feeling.
After watching this video,

fullTextZH: 我就想起去年冬天我在加拿大的经验。
fullTextEN: I thought of my experience in Canada last winter.
At that time,
the temperature was often more than minus 20 degrees,
The sky was dark before 4 o'clock.

fullTextZH: 每次我要出门买东西的时候，
fullTextEN: Every time I want to go out to buy things,

fullTextZH: 我都要穿很厚很厚的外套。
fullTextEN: I have to wear a very thick coat.
Although it's a very special experience,

fullTextZH: 但是对于我这个台湾人来说，
fullTextEN: but for me as a Taiwanese,
it's really too cold.
Although Taiwan's summer is very hot,

fullTextZH: 但是比起加拿大的冬天，
fullTextEN: but compared to Canada's winter,
I still prefer hot weather.
Because in hot weather,
you can go to the beach,
you can sunbathe,

fullTextZH: 你还可以做很多很多事情。
fullTextEN: you can also do many things.
What about you?

fullTextZH: 你们喜欢住在冷的国家，
fullTextEN: Do you like living in cold countries,
or hot countries?

fullTextZH: 欢迎你在下面留言告诉我哦！
fullTextEN: Feel free to leave a comment below!
Okay, this is today's

fullTextZH: 介绍世界上最冷的地方。
fullTextEN: introduction to the coldest places in the world.

fullTextZH: 希望你会喜欢今天的影片。
fullTextEN: I hope you will like today's video.

fullTextZH: 那我们就下支影片见喽，拜拜！
fullTextEN: Then we'll see you in the next video, bye!
